crossRefs.note: So Joab blew the trumpet; and all the people stood still, and pursued Israel no more, and they fought no more.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Joab
people.line: Son of Zeruiah, commander of David's army

translations.web: So Joab blew the trumpet; and all the people stood still, and pursued Israel no more, and they fought no more.
translations.bsb: So Joab blew the ram’s horn, and all the troops stopped; they no longer pursued Israel or continued to fight.
translations.kjv: So Joab blew a trumpet, and all the people stood still, and pursued after Israel no more, neither fought they any more.
translations.asv: So Joab blew the trumpet; and all the people stood still, and pursued after Israel no more, neither fought they any more.
